flowContents.comments: Kafka evx.vehicle.dtc -> thermal / critical DTCs -> evx.alert.priority. Built by nifi/deploy_flow.py (EV-Factory-to-Field-Lakehouse).
flowContents.name: EVX - Alert Router

properties.critical: SELECT event_id AS alert_id, vin, event_ts, dtc_code, severity, 'CRITICAL' AS reason, 'P1' AS priority, 'evx.vehicle.dtc' AS source_topic, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS routed_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL' AND (dtc_code IS NULL OR dtc_code NOT IN ('BMS-T01', 'MCU-T10'))
properties.thermal: SELECT event_id AS alert_id, vin, event_ts, dtc_code, severity, 'THERMAL' AS reason, 'P1' AS priority, 'evx.vehicle.dtc' AS source_topic, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS routed_at FROM FLOWFILE WHERE dtc_code IN ('BMS-T01', 'MCU-T10')
